messages:
anya: Quick rollcall — postmortem follow-ups from tonight's KV OOM. We need owners for: immediate guards, diagnostics/artifacts, and long-term refactor. One-line claims pls.

mike: I can own immediate guards. Plan: enable shard soft-cap at 93%, tighten small-object eviction, and push a canary. ETA 2h.

leigh: I'll own diagnostics + artifacts. Will collect heap snapshots, allocation flamegraphs, and add frag tiles to the ops dashboard. Uploading to s3 and linking to PI-2472.

leigh: ```
# take heap snapshot and upload
sudo pkill -USR1 kvd && sleep 6
scp ops@canary:/var/tmp/heap-*.prof .
aws s3 cp heap-*.prof s3://redwood-debug/kv-leaks/2799991111/
```

sriram: I'll pick allocator/GC experiments. Short plan: run canary with deferred-free and bump gc-threshold. Metric set: pause p99, residency slope, small_alloc_rate. RFC/experiment doc by EOD Fri.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary started by mike (deploy/kv-served v3.2.5-guard).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary healthy on 3/3 hosts after 20m. Residency decreased ~10%, no new OOMs observed.

anya: Ownership map: mike=short-term guards + telemetry, leigh=forensics + dashboard, sriram=allocator experiments, anya=postmortem writeup and prioritization.

mike: I'm also adding per-shard eviction counters and a residency heatmap tile. ETA for dashboards: Thu EOD.

leigh: First snapshots: high churn of tiny buffers held in put_batch and copy buffers. frag_ratio ~0.46 on impacted hosts. I'll attach flamegraphs to PI-2472.

sriram: If pooled buffers aren't drained, I'll prototype a bounded pool with idle-drain. Prototype branch and microbench by Wed.

anya: Add a recurring weekly frag-audit to ops calendar and a synthetic TestGrid job for small-alloc skew. Owners: leigh (tests) + mike (alerts). ETA: next Mon.

mike: Alert added: frag_ratio > 0.4 for 15m OR pooled_buffer_count > 4000 pages triggers page. Runbook linked.

leigh: I'll run synthetic skew tests at low rate and high rate to reproduce growth curves. Posting results here once available.

anya: Note: correlate this incident with PI-2472 historical incidents (Feb/Mar). Call out similar allocation sites and differences in growth slope.

ops-bot: reminder: PI-2472 updated with current owners and artifact links.

mike: Claiming eviction telemetry + alert tuning. ETA Thu.

leigh: Claiming synthetic TestGrid scenario and dashboard tiles. ETA Mon.

sriram: Claiming allocator prototype + experiment results. ETA Wed.

anya: Thanks. Keep this thread for short updates only; full writeup goes into PI-2472. If you pick subtasks later, reply with a one-line claim + ETA. Closing thread for now. :memo:
